method: Fetched all111 immutable full workflow blobs, matched every UTF8 length to untruncated tree metadata, hashed complete bodies. Inspected all event headers. Simple branch patterns are exact names or smoke/**; proposed branch matches none. Exact PR diff matches only unfiltered CI;15 other PR workflows exclude both changed paths. This is a scoped Actions trigger assessment, not a generic YAML validator or external-webhook inventory.

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    # Run on all pull requests (create and update)
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

# Cancel any in-progress run for the same branch/PR when a new commit is pushed, so superseded
# builds don't keep occupying runners. head_ref is set on pull_request events (the PR's source
# branch); for pushes it's empty, so we fall back to ref (e.g. refs/heads/main). Including the
# workflow name keeps groups from colliding with other workflows.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
